# Africa Customary Succession Extension

Customary succession rules across African ethnic groups: patrilineal/matrilineal systems, family council decisions, communal property, widow rights, lobola, land tenure, and constitutional challenges.

Source: [`v3/extensions/africa-customary/africa-customary.json`](../../../../v3/extensions/africa-customary/africa-customary.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/extensions/africa-customary/africa-customary.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ethnicGroup` | `string` | yes | The ethnic group whose customary succession law applies — determines the inheritance system (patrilineal, matrilineal, bilateral, or mixed) |
| `customaryRules` | array of [CustomarySuccessionRule](#def-CustomarySuccessionRule) | | |
| `familyCouncilDecisions` | array of [FamilyCouncilDecision](#def-FamilyCouncilDecision) | | |
| `communalPropertyDetails` | array of [CommunalPropertyDetail](#def-CommunalPropertyDetail) | | |
| `widowRights` | array of [WidowRights](#def-WidowRights) | | |
| `lobolaDetails` | `object` | | |
| `landTenureDetails` | array of `object` | | |
| `constitutionalChallenges` | array of `object` | | |
| `notes` | `string` | | |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
